$comment: Every setting of Explorer Extras, declared once. build.py writes the Windhawk settings block and the C++ settings table from it. See SPEC-settings-shell.md.

settings.name: Enable Columns
settings.description: Adds Columns to the View menu. Off removes it.

settings.name: Open new windows in Columns
settings.description: New Explorer windows open in Columns if it was your last layout. Picking another layout turns this off.

settings.name: Desktop column shows real items only
settings.description: Hides virtual items (This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel…) from the Desktop column.

settings.name: Mark remote items
settings.description: Shows a small icon on cloud-only files and on items on a network or a phone.

settings.name: Remember sort and grouping
settings.description: Each folder keeps its own sort and grouping. When off, every column uses the first folder’s.

settings.name: Remember column widths
settings.description: A column you resize reopens at that width.

settings.name: Remember Columns per folder
settings.description: Each folder remembers whether it was left in Columns. Opening it turns Columns on or off to match.

settings.name: Open folders while dragging
settings.description: Hold dragged items on a folder for about 0.7 s to open it in the next column.

settings.name: Border after the last column
settings.description: Draws a separator line on the right of the last column.

settings.name: Shift + double-click to even widths
settings.description: Shift + double-click a column border gives all columns the same width. They stay so until a border is double-clicked alone.

settings.name: Keep columns after choosing a file
settings.description: Columns to the right stay, dimmed, when you choose a file or several items. Off closes them.

settings.name: Keyboard on group headers
settings.description: Arrow keys reach group headers. Left, Right and Enter collapse and expand them.

settings.name: Double-click empty space to go up
settings.description: Goes up one folder. In the first column, the parent folder is added in front.

settings.name: Show the focus outline
settings.description: Draws an outline around the item under the keyboard cursor. The selection highlight always shows.

settings.name: Panel background
settings.description: Explorer uses its own file list colour. Theme uses the standard dark or light colour.

settings.name: Sidebar sets the first column
settings.description: Clicking Home, Gallery, OneDrive or a pinned folder makes it the first column. The tree (This PC, drives, Network) still follows the columns.

settings.name: Maximum column width
settings.description: Columns fit their longest name up to this width. Longer names are shortened.

settings.name: Write a debug log
settings.description: Writes Code\windhawk-lib\probes\logs\explorer-extras.log in your user folder, if it exists.

whatsNew: Extras in the View menu opens this window. Settings apply at once, and Reset goes back to Windhawk’s values.
Hold Shift and double-click a column border to give every column the same width.
Drag rows to another window, the desktop, the navigation pane or the tab strip. Hold them on a folder to open it.
Archives can be dragged out of, and a phone’s folders and OneDrive syncing show their own marks.
The toolbar’s Select all, Invert selection and Select none reach the columns.

strings.window.title: Explorer Extras
strings.home.title: Explorer Extras
strings.home.subtitle: Optional additions to File Explorer, each one with its own page and switch.
strings.tip.title: Tip
strings.tip.body: Choose Columns in the View menu of a File Explorer window. The Extras entry at the bottom of the ... menu on the toolbar opens this window.
strings.status.hooks.detail: The Explorer extension the mod hooks into.
strings.action.log.detail: The file the mod writes while it works, if its folder exists.
strings.action.copy.detail: Version, settings and state, as text, to paste in a message.
strings.action.reset.detail: Every setting goes back to what Windhawk’s page for the mod says.
strings.columns.title: Columns
strings.columns.subtitle: A Columns layout in the View menu: Miller columns drawn with Explorer’s own controls.
strings.columns.note: Changes apply at once. The mod keeps them in front of Windhawk’s page, and a later edit on that page for the same setting wins. Reset on the Explorer Extras page goes back to Windhawk’s values.
